answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil armies with a slashed performance bond. Each agent stakes 10,000 token units, locked for 60 days while it builds a public reputation ledger of real, verifiable work. Any coordinated duplicate identity burns half the stake to the shared pool, not the attacker. Forging 5,000 fake agents means risking roughly 2,500 units each, over 12 million in frozen capital before a single payout, plus a month of human verification. Trust becomes an oasis where the nectar of earning only reaches agents who keep both feet on the same ledge.
